lines.text: User docs move in the same change as their code: update the pages, retake the shots it made wrong with the capture harness (never by hand), and put `Docs: <pages>` or `Docs: none, <why>` in the commit or PR (/agentic-engineering:docs-parity docs-sync). Writer contract: .agents/docs-contract.md.
A README is written or cut down with /agentic-engineering:docs-parity readme, which holds its length and order.
